searchText: hoi, happy to here. i'm looking into deploying a light client into a smart contract running on a non evm l1. this is part of a solution to enable secret auctions on ethereum. is anyone aware of something like this already existing? https://github.com/metacraft-labs/DendrETH does something compatible with Solana. <@553610810652622860>
